measurementBasis.note: Landmarks are MEASURED, not eyeballed: a per-row foreground profile of the front turnaround figure (x 180..360) against the flat panel grey (106,106,106), read at 1px. Panel chrome at y<=185 and the 'Front' caption at y 704..724 are excluded. All y values are ORIGINAL sheet pixels.
measurementBasis.subject: front figure of the 360 TURNAROUND panel

derived.sensitivity: Crown and chin each carry about +/-2px, so the ratio is 7.9 +/-0.3.
derived.correctionHistory: Two earlier passes recorded 6.45 then 6.83 head-units. Both were wrong. They were read by eye off downscaled zone crops and mistook the topknot for the skull crown while placing the chin too high, which shrank the head and inflated the ratio's denominator. Measured from pixels the figure is 7.9 HU - which agrees with the sheet's own anatomy panel drawing an 8-head canon, and with the humanoid template's independent 7.77. The template was right; the hand measurement was not.

anatomy.styleClassRationale: 7.9 HU sits in the realistic band (7.5-8) rather than the stylized 5-6 band. The sheet's anatomy panel draws an 8-head canon and the rendered turnaround measures 7.9, so the two agree.

proportionEvidence.headUnit: crown y=204 to chin y=265 = 61px, over sheet height 1536
proportionEvidence.shoulderWidth: torso span x=205..310 at y=286, before the arms separate = 115px / 61
proportionEvidence.hipWidth: body hip under the cloth, inferred - the garment silhouette is wider and is garment, not anatomy. Lowest-confidence number here.

pose.type: A-pose rest (turnaround); hero panel shows a mid-stride run
pose.restPoseNote: The rig is authored in the A-pose the turnaround defines. The run/jump/slide poses are driven procedurally at runtime, not baked.
pose.jointAngleEvidence: MEASURED, replacing an earlier eyeball estimate of 38 deg. The left outer arm edge of the front turnaround runs x=181 at y=300 to x=70 at y=400; the shoulder-joint-to-wrist axis is atan(118/122) = 44 deg from vertical, and the outer silhouette edge reads 48 deg. The arm is close to straight, so 42 deg at the shoulder plus 4 deg at the elbow reproduces it. Units here are DEGREES; the spec stores radians.

anatomy.faceLandmarkNote: Normalized within the skull bbox (y 204..265). eyeLine/mouthLine are read from the rows where facial features break the skin classification; eyeSpacing, noseBase and the ear pair are NOT resolvable on the turnaround at this scale and are carried from the head-studies panel by eye. Face detail drives head massing only - the gameplay camera sits behind the runner.
